title: runNotebooks.py: the stored outputs without the user's settings
author: Claude-JG
description: tools/runNotebooks.py runs the notebooks with the settings of ~/.exudyn/config.json of the machine, so the stored outputs carry its note, as in python/Notebooks/reference/HT.ipynb, and may depend on its settings. Decided: the runner sets EXUDYN_NO_USER_SETTINGS for every notebook.
releaseNotes: tools/runNotebooks.py runs the notebooks without the settings of the user, EXUDYN_NO_USER_SETTINGS.
